positions.name: RehearsalAsConditionOfCapability
positions.frame: what justifies mandating a fixed rehearsal cadence — does the mandate rest on treating rehearsal itself as the condition for actually having the capability?
positions.why: src-1 is Quinton's directive fixing the monthly cadence going forward; src-2 is his immediately following aphorism equating an unrehearsed rollback with no rollback at all. Read together, the directive reads as backed by the principle rather than standing as bare command: the cadence is mandated because rehearsal is framed as constitutive of actually possessing the capability, not optional practice on top of it. The dimensional reads support this pairing — src-1 carries mandate/pressure and decision, src-2 carries rational-persuasion and principle — a command-then-rationale sequence rather than two independent acts. No tension to resolve; the two segments cohere as directive-plus-justification from the same speaker in immediate sequence.

placements.title: rehearsal is the proof of actual capability
placements.frame: Does this expression treat an operational capability as real only to the extent it has been rehearsed and institutionalized — cadence set, owner named — rather than assumed to exist by default?
placements.why: src-1 mandates a standing monthly rehearsal cadence for Atlas rollback; src-2 supplies the constitutive principle behind it — an unrehearsed rollback is not actually possessed — which the position pass already reads as directive-plus-justification from the same speaker in sequence. This passes the narrative grain test: 'rehearsal proves capability' is a subject future envelopes about other systems/capabilities can keep feeding, not a one-time fact. src-3 and src-4 are the notebook's administrative encoding of that same decision (the cadence field restates src-1's schedule; the owner field names who is accountable for sustaining the rehearsal practice) — both are position-grain facts that evidence this theme's institutionalization rather than themes of their own, so they join this leaf's support rather than minting separately (per the grain-test example: a measurement/fact supports the leaf its theme evidences, it doesn't get its own).
